所需文件和安装位置

扩散模型

https://civitai.com/models/1514080

### 文本编码器

将以下文件放入ComfyUI/模型/text_encoders/:

- 夹子-L：[clip_l.safetensors]）

- T5XXL 选项：

VAE

所需的自定义节点

要启用其他 FlexTools 功能，请将以下存储库克隆到您的自定义节点目录：

git 克隆 https://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-FlexTools

🛠️ ComfyUI 的 FlexTools 和 OllamaGemini 设置指南

📥 1. 克隆所需的自定义节点

导航到 ComfyUI custom_nodes 目录

cd /路径/到/ComfyUI/custom_nodes

克隆 ComfyUI 的 FlexTools

git 克隆 https://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-FlexTools

克隆 ComfyUI 的 OllamaGemini 扩展

git 克隆 https://github.com/al-swaiti/ComfyUI-OllamaGemini.git

🔑 2. API 密钥设置

### ✨ 获取 API 密钥

- 双子座 API 密钥→ [Google MakerSuite](https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey)

- OpenAI API 密钥→ [开AI账户](https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys)

- 人类克劳德·基→ [人类控制台](https://console.anthropic.com/)

- Qwen API 密钥→ [Qwen 官方](https://qwen.aliyun.com/)

-（可选）本地奥拉马 URL → http://localhost:11434（默认）

---

### ⚙️ 配置.json

1. 导航到 OllamaGemini 扩展文件夹：

cd /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-OllamaGemini

2. 创建或编辑配置.json:

```json

{

"GEMINI_API_KEY": "your_gemini_api_key",

"OPENAI_API_KEY": "your_openai_api_key",

"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY":"your_claude_api_key",

“OLLAMA_URL”：“http://localhost:11434",

"QWEN_API_KEY": "your_qwen_api_key"

}

```

3. 保存文件。

---

🚀 你准备好了！

- 重新启动 ComfyUI。

- 在 UI 中验证两者Flex工具和奥拉马双子座节点可用。

享受增强的功能！ 🎉

Required Files and Installation Locations

Diffusion Model

- Download and placeflex.2-preview.safetensors

https://civitai.com/models/1514080

ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

### Text Encoders

Place the following files inComfyUI/models/text_encoders/:

- CLIP-L:[clip_l.safetensors])

- T5XXL Options:

- Option 1 (FP8): [t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors]

- Option 2 (FP16): [t5xxl_fp16.safetensors]

VAE

- Download link: [ae.safetensors]

-ComfyUI/models/vae/

Required Custom Node

To enable additional FlexTools functionality, clone the following repository into yourcustom_nodesdirectory:

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-FlexTools

🛠️ FlexTools & OllamaGemini Setup Guide for ComfyUI

📥 1. Clone Required Custom Nodes

Navigate to ComfyUI custom_nodes directory

cd /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes

Clone FlexTools for ComfyUI

git clone https://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-FlexTools

Clone OllamaGemini Extension for ComfyUI

git clone https://github.com/al-swaiti/ComfyUI-OllamaGemini.git

🔑 2. API Key Setup

### ✨ Obtaining API Keys

- Gemini API Key→ [Google MakerSuite](https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey)

- OpenAI API Key→ [OpenAI Account](https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys)

- Anthropic Claude Key→ [Anthropic Console](https://console.anthropic.com/)

- Qwen API Key→ [Qwen Official](https://qwen.aliyun.com/)

- (Optional)Local Ollama URL → http://localhost:11434(default)

---

### ⚙️ config.json

1. Navigate into the OllamaGemini extension folder:

cd /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-OllamaGemini

2. Create or editconfig.json:

```json

{

"GEMINI_API_KEY": "your_gemini_api_key",

"OPENAI_API_KEY": "your_openai_api_key",

"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY":"your_claude_api_key",

"OLLAMA_URL": "http://localhost:11434",

"QWEN_API_KEY": "your_qwen_api_key"

}

```

3. Save the file.

---

🚀 You’re Ready!

- Restart ComfyUI.

- Verify in the UI that bothFlexToolsandOllamaGemininodes are available.

Enjoy enhanced functionality! 🎉

│ └── vae/

│ └── ae.safetensors

└── custom_nodes/

└── ComfyUI-FlexTools/ # git clonehttps://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-FlexTools
